tint: multiply ONLY neutral grey pixels (r == g == b): rgb * role / 255; faces, skin, effects are coloured and drawn as is
scale: 12x logical pixel; the pixel frame uses 6x, so draw at 0.5x, nearest-neighbour
files: <name>/<state>_<i>.png, all frames of one object share size, anchor and top
generic_states: catch (squash-stretch) and flinch (shake) exist for every object
fixed_colour: sprites with tint=false are drawn as is: the material colour (cardboard) carries meaning; state is shown by face, stickers and badges
